cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Tell Me Why
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal the motive behind a choice by offering small pieces of your own truth as bait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. We're circling the station. I avoid my old office too. Why this route?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My former boss catches this train.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I told mine I'd become a novelist. What did you tell yours?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That I had a better offer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've carried the same blank notebook past mine for a year. Are you avoiding him because there wasn't a better offer?

mechanism: A corrects the difference between a public story and the motive for avoidance while offering their own unfinished-novel truth to draw B out.
confusable: A sympathetic confession alone does not test motive; S03 must control the precision of the account being elicited.
comparison: Employment shame between acquaintances differs from a close-friend preference dispute.
seedUse: Use station detour and false better-offer claim; let A separate facts and explanations as bait is offered.
